correctness.rationale: Full proof: Fourier-character Schmidt decomposition makes entropy rank_Fp(D). The full adjacency is off-diagonal in checkerboard order and corresponds to the Laurent multiplier (x+y)(1+xy)/(xy). Splitting x^m-1, y^n-1 into p-power root multiplicities yields two d0-point spectral branches meeting at precisely (1,-1),(-1,1). Ordinary local points each contribute min(P,Q); at crossings, monic-quadratic freeness and Frobenius show quotient dimension 2 min(P,Q) when P!=Q, or 2P-1 when P=Q. Counting gives full nullity 2g (unequal valuations) or 2g-2 (equal), whence cut rank mn/2-g+delta. No extrapolation from finite cases. Exact independent Gaussian elimination: 420 grids over p=3,5,7,11 and 15 local intersection quotient computations, all passing. Critical assumptions: p odd, m,n even >=4, unit edge weights, pure states.

value.rationale: This solves a natural complete cut-entanglement invariant for prime-dimensional qudit cluster states on an entire two-parameter family of periodic square lattices. The new p-adic equality test captures a nonsemisimple spectral branching effect, gives an explicit one-dit arithmetic phase switch, and distinguishes these systems from their characteristic-two analogues. The structural local-intersection lemma is reusable in modular periodic-convolution calculations. It is not an arbitrary finite slice or merely a generic cut-rank identity, and it suggests concrete tuning of grid periods versus local qudit prime dimension.
